notes: The four models whose TLC runs timed out at 60 s were rerun with 2 seeds and a 900 s timeout (dive built from d04a3a88); their rows are those reruns.

agree-with-simulator: both simulators report the same class, which the exhaustive golden does not. Deadlocks on MCtcp, MCInnerSequential and MCLamportMutex are states with no successor inside the CONSTRAINT, which TLC -simulate also reports as deadlock (10 of 10 seeds); other-error models are ASSUME-only or constant-only modules that both simulators reject for having no behavior.

tlc-contradicts-golden: TLC -simulate reports a class that model checking refutes. SDP_Attack_Spec, SDP_Attack_New_Solution_Spec and MCYoYoNoPruning are D-043 (receipts E1 and T5 in crates/dive-sim/tests/fixtures/temporal/oracle.json); CoffeeCan3000Beans fails in TLC with 'Too many possible next states'; TokenRing fails in TLC with an undefined identifier.
registered-divergence: MCDistributedReplicatedLog is D-037 (TLC closes loops on VIEW fingerprints).
